models.title: ivrit.ai Hebrew whisper
models.summary: Hebrew with English terms, or English. large-v3-turbo fine-tuned by ivrit.ai, q8_0, with whisper tiny to tell Hebrew from English.
models.source: ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-ggml ggml-model.bin (sha256 c8090411113357097bfafc2b8e228ec1639fa7f5fe4ecb5d054ac0ccef8641b1), quantized to q8_0 with whisper.cpp v1.9.1 whisper-quantize. VAD: ggml-org/whisper-vad ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin (MIT). Language ID: ggerganov/whisper.cpp ggml-tiny-q8_0.bin (byte-identical, revision 5359861c739e955e79d9a303bcbc70fb988958b1; MIT, OpenAI whisper tiny).

models.title: Multilingual whisper
models.summary: OpenAI large-v3-turbo, q5_0. Detects the language; weaker Hebrew.
models.source: ggerganov/whisper.cpp ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin (byte-identical; reproduced with whisper-quantize q5_0 from ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin). VAD: ggml-org/whisper-vad ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin (MIT).

models.title: ivrit.ai Hebrew streaming Zipformer
models.summary: Live Hebrew transcription for Talk: a 66M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer, int8, decoding 1.28 s chunks as you speak. English terms come out spelled letter by letter.
models.source: zipformer2-66m-streaming-he by Yakov Kolani (thewh1teagle/zipformer2-66m-streaming-he, revision 6c07526ebfdfc71d12ed4ce6aaebe32774a2613a, CC-BY-4.0), as mirrored by ivrit.ai (ivrit-ai/zipformer2-66m-streaming-he, revision ee769a2a13b887f91572eec349458bfb0fe79e7a): sherpa-onnx/encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, joiner.int8.onnx and tokens.txt, byte-identical, renamed with the model's name in front. Fine-tuned from icefall's streaming Zipformer (Apache-2.0) on ivrit.ai audio. VAD: ggml-org/whisper-vad ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin (MIT), the models-v1 file.

models.title: Smart Turn v3.2
models.summary: End-of-turn detection for Talk: whether you have finished speaking, from the last 8 s of audio. int8, on the CPU. No Hebrew in its training data, so Talk only logs it at first.
models.source: pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 smart-turn-v3.2-cpu.onnx (revision f766f81d3cfdf7737ac64aad813d91bbfd56bf93), byte-identical: Smart Turn v3.2 by Daily (BSD-2-Clause), a Whisper Tiny encoder (MIT, OpenAI) with a linear classifier head, quantized to int8 by its authors.
